_about: Climatology context for the Seasonal Focus 10 report (6 Oct 2026). Web-sourced, NOT measured, NOT a ranking input: written after the ranking to explain it. 'verified' = the page was opened and the claim read on it; 'search summary' = the claim is the web-search tool's summary of the page, which could not be opened from the sandbox (egress proxy blocked the domain).

lucknow.note: Post-monsoon season (Oct-Nov) follows the SW monsoon's end in September; calm and very light winds are most frequent in this season.

karachi.note: October is a transition month after the monsoon withdraws in September; in November dry continental winds set up over Pakistan, and October-November bring very little rain to Sindh.

helsinki.note: Cloud cover is abundant in Finland in autumn and winter (about 65-85% of the sky); clear days are least frequent in November and December.

wellington.note: Southern Hemisphere spring; spring is consistently Wellington's windiest season.

tel_aviv.note: Start of the rainy season: early-season rain in Israel is localized (rainy spots beside dry areas); the main rainy season runs November-April.

milan.note: October and November are among Lombardy's rainiest months; frequent fog in the plain under anticyclones after wet spells (ARPA Lombardia news on Oct 2024).

chicago.note: Continental climate with frequent short fluctuations in temperature; Chicago lies close to well-defined storm tracks.

moscow.note: No climatology source could be opened or found at an official domain in this session; the reason rests on the numbers only.

miami.note: End of the wet (summer) season: NWS Miami gives a median end date of 17 October (earliest 24 Sep, latest 1 Nov) over 42 years.

amsterdam.note: The Dutch storm season starts in September and runs through the winter half; the first storm often comes in autumn.

cape_town.note: Southern Hemisphere spring; warm sunny weather returns with the prevailing south-easterly ('Cape doctor').

busan.note: East Asian winter monsoon onset: cold-surge frequency peaks in November (and March).

qingdao.note: East Asian winter monsoon onset: cold-surge frequency peaks in November (and March).

beijing.note: East Asian winter monsoon onset: cold-surge frequency peaks in November (and March); cold anomalies of some outbreak types exceed -8 C in northern China.

zhengzhou.note: East Asian winter monsoon onset: cold-surge frequency peaks in November (and March).

wuhan.note: East Asian winter monsoon onset: cold-surge frequency peaks in November (and March).

shenzhen.note: Northeast monsoon onset: from early October the subtropical ridge retreats south and dry, cold northern air frequently reaches the south China coast.

guangzhou.note: Northeast monsoon onset: from early October the subtropical ridge retreats south and dry, cold northern air frequently reaches the south China coast.

kuala_lumpur.note: Inter-monsoon (October-November): light variable winds, usually clear mornings, and thunderstorms in the afternoon and early evening.

sao_paulo.note: Southern Hemisphere spring is a transition season (cold dry winter to warm wet summer); the rainy season begins in October, and cold fronts bring sharp temperature drops.
